## Principles

- Scripts run top-to-bottom with no hidden state.
- Paths are project-relative (`here::here()`), never absolute.
- A single agreed random seed is set once per analysis so results are reproducible.

## Project structure

*Describe the expected layout of an analysis project (e.g. `data/`, `R/`, `output/`) so work is consistent across the team.*

## Example: a minimal, reproducible snippet

Example code blocks in this documentation follow the study's R conventions — tidyverse-first, native pipe, explicit `dplyr::` on `select()`/`filter()` where any namespace conflict is possible.

```r
library(tidyverse)

ncc_clean |>
  dplyr::filter(age >= 18) |>
  dplyr::group_by(sex, age_group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n    = dplyr::n(),
    prev = mean(post_covid, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
